page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.48xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs provided by AMD EPYC 9T24 processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between instances and cloud services. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this configuration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of dedicated AMD EPYC cores provides substantial compute capacity per virtual machine, reducing the overhead of managing multiple smaller instances. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance suitable for compute-intensive workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local storage. Appropriate workloads include high-performance computing, batch processing, scientific modeling, large-scale web serving, and distributed analytics.
